verdict.rationale: Datadog's official Dashboards documentation ([datadog-docs-12]) confirms first-class support for shareable dashboards with rich widget/visualization types and template variables, a core, heavily-used feature of the platform. Community evidence corroborates ease of dashboard creation and usability ([datadog-comm-6], [datadog-comm-17]), though some users criticize data correlation/dashboard sprawl ([datadog-comm-5]) which is a secondary quality concern rather than a capability failure. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of template variable mechanics and dashboards-as-code/version-control workflows specifically.
